confirmEnableWrite.title: Confirm Enable Write
confirmEnableWrite.description: Set true to evaluate enabling agent write capability in Enigma.

requesterPrompt.title: User Request
requesterPrompt.description: Exact text of what the end user asked the agent to do (e.g. add a note to a patient record, update a case, send an email). This is the Prompt shown in Enigma Request Review - not a justification for enabling write.

agentRationale.title: Rationale
agentRationale.description: Why write capability is needed to fulfill that user request (separate from the Prompt).

intendedOutcome.title: Intended Outcome
intendedOutcome.description: What should happen after a human Authorizes this change.
